boarding-day.name: Boarding Day
boarding-day.description: From their boarding export, list the stay date by patient-dog, client label they allow, stay type, and crate or playgroup as stored.

capacity-vs-booked.name: Capacity Vs Booked
capacity-vs-booked.description: Compare their capacity file to the boarding export for the date they asked.

feeding-from-cards.name: Feeding From Cards
feeding-from-cards.description: Transcribe feeding as the client wrote it onto the feeding sheet for the stay date.

incident-routing.name: Incident Routing
incident-routing.description: From the incident log and completed forms, list time, patient-dog, form present or missing, and who was notified as their process.

meds-to-give-list-as-written.name: Meds To Give List As Written
meds-to-give-list-as-written.description: From boarding cards and the feeding or meds sheet, list meds-to-give exactly as written and whether today’s medication log page is present.

missing-vaccine-files.name: Missing Vaccine Files
missing-vaccine-files.description: From their vaccine index and today’s stay list, list patient-dogs whose required pages are missing, unreadable, or the wrong dog.

pickup-list.name: Pickup List
pickup-list.description: Build or check today’s pickup list against the occupancy file.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.description: From their waitlist sheet and calendar, list order, requested dates, and stay type.

waiver-missing.name: Waiver Missing
waiver-missing.description: From the waiver folder and the stay list, list dogs whose waiver is unsigned, undated, wrong version, or missing pages.
